about_the_game:
Enjoy Ultra High Quality in the PC version of Sivar Race El Salvador! with 4K Shading and Textures with Reflections and Lights of the next level.

Can you imagine tuning a bus to the point where everyone looks at it? In Sivar Race you can make it happen! Add stickers, LED lights, spoilers, exhausts, crazy colors, rims, and anything you can think of to make your bus or coaster the toughest of them all. There are no limits to your creativity here: your style rules. Compete in epic races through incredible places in El Salvador.

Win money in the races, and use it to improve your Bus or Coster so that everyone respects you.

With brutal graphics, deluxe cinematics and music that puts you in race mode, Sivar Race El Salvador is all you need to race, tune and be the king of the SV street. Will it be done or won't it be done?

At the beginning you will have a couple of vehicles inspired by the most famous buses and coasters in the streets of El Salvador. Choose the one you like the most and start transforming it into the customized beast you always dreamed of, your creativity is the limit!

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660, 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX Vega 56, 8 GB or Intel Arc A580, 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
